mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_publication_sku_ext ( sku_id, target_period, volume_label, edition_label, isbn, remark, deleted ) VALUES ( #{ext.skuId}, #{ext.targetPeriod}, #{ext.volumeLabel}, #{ext.editionLabel}, #{ext.isbn}, #{ext.remark}, b'0' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_period = VALUES(target_period), volume_label = VALUES(volume_label), edition_label = VALUES(edition_label), isbn = VALUES(isbn), remark = VALUES(remark), deleted = b'0', update_time = NOW()
